Class LocalPlayerState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.view.localState.LocalPlayerState
public class LocalPlayerState extends Object
Represents the local state of a player in the game.

    • LocalPlayerState

      public LocalPlayerState(String nickname, Color color)
      Constructs a new LocalPlayerState with the given nickname and color. Initializes prestige points and food to 0, and empty lists for tribe and buildings.
      Parameters:
      nickname - The nickname of the player.
      color - The color associated with the player.
